scope: Prepared conditional closeout and independent verification parameters only; no database or network action executed
executionGate: Root observes real owner UI permanent deletion for exactly Issues #1, #2, #3
Independent current GitHub repository metadata read succeeds with same ID/name and private visibility
Each exact Issue API request explicitly reports HTTP 404 under the same authorized connection
The same authorized connection successfully returns the complete state=all Issue list with zero items
Root has verified normal late reconcile preserved the diagnostic deletion intent and resolved original Issue #2 identity; all SQL guards match
evidenceRules: 404 alone is insufficient: require successful private repo metadata and successful complete Issues list under the same connection
401, 403, missing-scope, disconnected-auth, transport failures, unavailable metadata/list, or an error with no explicit HTTP status are BLOCKED or UNKNOWN, never deletion PASS
A nonempty list or any surviving exact Issue is not complete cleanup; preserve the actual response
Closing an Issue does not qualify: state=all must be empty and exact Issue resource must be unavailable after root observed permanent deletion
Private raw connector output stays in 0700 directory with 0600 files; public evidence contains only metadata, timestamps, hashes, booleans and explicit status
Only root executes conditional state transitions after the entire gate; zero changed rows requires inspecting the existing guards rather than loosening them
Keep tombstones and remaining retention/backup limits; this cannot prove erasure of provider backups
mutationRule: Only SET state=deleted with exact feedbackID, Issue number/node, delete_requested=1, payload IS NULL and state=deletion_pending; no other fields, clock changes, row deletion or identity reuse
